articles.title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE - Official Trailer - IGN
articles.summary:
Check out the trailer for V/H/S/MIXTAPE, an upcoming horror film featuring new segments from directors Ernest Dickerson, Flying Lotus, Tobias Forge, David Moreau, RZA, and Renee Zhan. The latest installment pushes the boundaries of found footage with four wildly original stories that each put a unique spin on the terrifying relationship between sound and fear. V/HS/MIXTAPE features GWAR and Jim Henson's Creature Shop. V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the franchise's signature found-footage horror up to eleven with an electrifying new anthology where music and sound become the source of terror. United by a theme that explores the power of music, rhythm, and audio to haunt, possess, transform, and destroy, the film blends cosmic horror, psychological suspense, outrageous splatter, and groundbreaking practical effects into one unforgettable mixtape of nightmares.V/H/S/MIXTAPE is produced by Josh Goldbloom, Steven Schneider, Roy Lee, Michael Schreiber, and Brad Miska. Ben Ross and Rami Yasin serve as executive producers. It is written by Zoe Cooper, David Moreau, Ernest Dickerson, RZA, and Matt Landsman.

V/H/S/MIXTAPE streams on Shudder beginning October 9, 2026.

articles.title: Rockstar’s GTA VI collectible box packs a “swizzle stick,”  mirror, hat, and more for $399.99, but no game.
articles.summary:
Not only is the price higher than the $90 GTA IV and $150 GTA V collectible sets, but this time around Rockstar says “Grand Theft Auto VI game sold separately,” for $79.99 or $99.99, respectively.
What you do get in that $400 box is a 6-inch figurine of Macca the Gator with a stash compartment, a matching spoon and magnetic mirror that are definitely not made to snort stuff stored in said stash compartment, plus GTA-branded Oakley sunglasses, hat, a crossbody bag, a shot glass, stickers, pins, and a souvenir poster.
